subject: Question harness built on branch claude/project-thread-c4ldi5
body: Cam asked for a working question harness. It implements onboarding M1-M3 for playbook section 1 plus core submodalities (no contrast/drivers) under onboarding/script, onboarding/src/{engine,voice,harness,playback}, onboarding/harness and onboarding/test. Decision D-onboarding-012. Please build on it rather than in parallel; the draft PR will be linked on the board.
